title: G Pen Elite II Portable Vaporizer by Grenco (taxes extra)
description:
The G Pen Elite II is the next evolution in portable, ground material vaporization technology.

Engineered with a patented clean air intake and coaxial convection
and conduction dual heater system, the G Pen Elite II delivers pure and perfectly
controlled vapor for each dose. Equipped with a full color, hi-res display, and
WiFi updateable firmware, the customizable heat options enable elite flavor
optimization and effects. Encased in a durable zinc-alloy body, the G Pen Elite II
includes a built-in pick tool, a protective silicone sleeve, and a hemp travel case
for convenient and secure portability.

Our review:
We are extra impressed with the G Pen Elite II, one of the best dry herb portables we have used. The unit is solid, especially the magnetic mouthpiece, huge improvement over the original Elite. The digital display looks great and is easy to use. Charging time was reasonable and heat up time is very impressive. We are happy with the vapor quality, one of the better portable vaporizer experiences. We also liked the kit and the included case. Highly recommended!

Features:
• Convection & Conduction Dual-Heater System
• Draw-Activated Convection Boost Heating With LED Indicator
• Magnetic Zirconia Mouthpiece With Spiral Ceramic Vapor Cooler
• Full Ceramic Heating Chamber (Up To 0.5G Capacity)
• Full Color, High-Resolution Display
• Rechargeable 2100MAH Lithium-Ion Battery (~60 Minutes of Vape Time)
• Temperature Control Between 200°F-430°F (93-221°C)
• Clean Air Intake With Finger Carb Airflow Control
• Haptic Feedback
• WiFi Updateable Firmware
• USB-C Fast Charging (~1.5 hours)
• Built-in Pick Tool
• Hemp Travel Case & Silicone Sleeve

Included in the Kit:
1 G PEN ELITE II VAPORIZER (FOR DRY HERB)
1 G PEN ELITE II SILICONE SLEEVE
1 USB TO USB-C CHARGING CABLE
1 HEMP TRAVEL CASE
1 PICK TOOL

BONUS ITEM: 4 Piece Premium Grinder, 2 Sticks, 1 Cleaning Brush
